text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you went that far into the<n>mountains by
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the weather and the skies were just<n>so
pleasant. I drifted along with the<n>breeze, and
found myself quite far from<n>the school.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A-amazing! So how did you get back?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was guided by the comforting breeze<n>and the
clouds themselves.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can see that! I had a similar<n>experience
before!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Bakushin O! You can read the<n>wind and the
clouds? H-how do you do<n>it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It was when I was still small and cute as a<n>button. I
heard about the "first storm of<n>spring," and
couldn't take my mind off<n>that beginning part.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't possibly let anyone besides<n>me be
crowned as "first" anything!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So I took off running in the direction of<n>those
winds, and before I knew it, I was<n>in some far-off
town!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's so easy to get swept away in a gale,<n>isn't it?
They have carried me across<n>mountains before.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You talk as if that's a common<n>occurrence... I
never knew the wind was<n>so powerful...
